cards.english_title: Kochi tightens monitoring after dog-catching complaints
cards.korean_desc: 코치 법인은 검사관을 임명한다. 서부 코치 의원들은 방문이 적었다고 말했다. 시장은 15일 일정을 준비한다. 10월 30일까지 94마리만 잡혔다.
cards.english_desc: Kochi Corporation will appoint an inspector to monitor dog-catching squads across the city. Councillors from West Kochi complained that squads visited their divisions less often. The mayor plans a fifteen-day schedule, with changes allowed only during emergencies. By October 30, the corporation had captured only 94 dogs.
cards.takeaway_english: Kochi’s new records may show whether unequal service was real or only alleged.
cards.takeaway_korean: 새 기록은 서비스 격차의 진실을 보여줄 수 있다.

why_it_matters.english: The city’s sterilisation capacity is higher than its recent capture totals.
why_it_matters.korean: 도시의 중성화 능력이 최근 포획보다 높다.

parties.label: Kochi Corporation
parties.english: It will coordinate requests and record each operation by division.

parties.label: West Kochi councillors

parties.korean: 서부 코치 의원들은 서비스가 적었다고 말했다.

parties.label: Dog-catching squads
parties.english: They face limited staffing and pressure to work more consistently.

views.label: Mayor V.K. Minimol
views.english: A schedule and monitoring system could improve fairness without ending the contract.
views.korean: 일정과 감시가 공정성을 높일 수 있다.

views.label: BJP councillor Priya Prasanth
views.english: Better cages and basic infrastructure are needed, not blame aimed only at catchers.
views.korean: 포획대만 탓하지 말고 시설을 늘려야 한다.

disagree.english: Other councillors argue that earlier decisions were repeatedly ignored and urgent requests were delayed.
disagree.korean: 다른 의원들은 결정이 무시되고 요청이 늦었다고 말한다.

cards.english_title: Nvidia investigates reports targeting CEO Jensen Huang
cards.korean_desc: 엔비디아는 11월 8일 황 CEO를 조사했다. 미국 정보기관은 앨리스 황을 베이징과 연결했다. 이사회는 현재 비밀 유출 근거가 없다고 말했다. 황은 관계를 인정하고 조사에 협조한다.
cards.english_desc: Nvidia opened an investigation on November 8 after reports targeted CEO Jensen Huang. U.S. intelligence reportedly linked Alice Huang to information gathering for Beijing. The board says there is no current reason to believe Nvidia secrets were compromised. Jensen Huang said he will cooperate with the review after acknowledging an intimate relationship.
cards.hook: Nvidia is investigating a reported foreign intelligence effort.
cards.takeaway_english: The board’s investigation must separate confirmed facts from intelligence claims.
cards.takeaway_korean: 이사회는 확인된 사실과 정보기관 주장을 나눠야 한다.

why_it_matters.english: Nvidia makes advanced AI chips at the center of U.S.-China technology competition.
why_it_matters.korean: 엔비디아는 미중 기술 경쟁의 핵심 칩을 만든다.

why_it_matters.english: The case could affect trust in corporate security and sensitive business relationships.
why_it_matters.korean: 이 사건은 기업 보안과 사업 관계의 신뢰에 영향을 줄 수 있다.

parties.label: Nvidia’s board
parties.english: It opened an independent investigation and says no secrets are known to be compromised.
parties.korean: 이사회는 독립 조사를 시작했고 유출 증거가 없다고 말했다.

parties.label: Jensen Huang
parties.english: He acknowledged an intimate relationship and promised to cooperate with the review.
parties.korean: 황은 관계를 인정하고 조사에 협조하기로 했다.

parties.label: Alice Huang
parties.english: She is identified by U.S. intelligence reporting as a Chinese executive linked to Beijing.
parties.korean: 앨리스 황은 베이징과 연결된 중국인 간부로 지목됐다.

views.label: Nvidia’s board
views.english: The inquiry is necessary, but there is currently no reason to believe Nvidia secrets were compromised.
views.korean: 조사는 필요하지만 비밀 유출 근거는 없다고 본다.

views.label: U.S. intelligence reporting
views.english: Alice Huang was allegedly gathering information for Beijing through her relationship with Jensen Huang.
views.korean: 앨리스 황이 관계를 통해 베이징 정보를 모았다고 본다.

disagree.english: The allegations remain under investigation, and public evidence does not establish that Nvidia secrets were accessed.
disagree.korean: 의혹은 조사 중이며 비밀 접근은 확인되지 않았다.

cards.english_title: Bangalore Card Show returns after a surprisingly big debut
cards.korean_desc: 카드쇼 2.0이 11월 14일과 15일 돌아온다. 6월 첫 행사에 약 1,200명이 왔다. 방문객은 교환하고 대회와 수업에 참여한다. 창립자들은 내년 뭄바이와 하이데라바드를 원한다.
cards.english_desc: Bangalore Card Show 2.0 returns to Bengaluru on November 14 and 15, 2026. Its June debut attracted nearly 1,200 people, surprising the founders. Visitors can trade cards, enter tournaments, learn games and meet vendors. The founders hope to take the show to Mumbai and Hyderabad next year.

cards.takeaway_english: Bangalore’s card scene is shifting from private collecting toward public community play.

why_it_matters.korean: 인도에는 공식 카드 플랫폼이 없어 수집가들이 소셜미디어에 의존한다.

why_it_matters.english: The event gives beginners a place to learn before spending money.

cards.english_title: Possible Love turns class, desire and marriage into a prize contender
cards.korean_desc: 이창동의 가능한 사랑은 두 부부를 따라간다. 파업과 해고와 다큐멘터리가 관계를 만든다. 영화는 질투와 특권과 촬영 윤리를 살핀다. 한국은 영화를 99회 오스카에 출품했다.
cards.english_desc: Lee Chang-dong’s Possible Love follows two married couples from opposite economic worlds. Their connection grows after a factory strike, layoffs and a documentary project. The film examines envy, privilege and the ethics of filming other people’s hardship. South Korea selected the film for the 99th Academy Awards international feature category.
cards.hook: Lee Chang-dong’s new film turns class tension into drama.
cards.takeaway_english: Possible Love asks whether closeness can survive when wealth keeps the power unequal.
cards.takeaway_korean: 영화는 부의 불평등 속에서도 가까워질 수 있는지 묻는다.

why_it_matters.english: The film connects private desire with labor conflict and economic inequality.
why_it_matters.korean: 영화는 욕망을 노동 갈등과 경제 불평등에 연결한다.

why_it_matters.english: Its Oscar submission gives a wider audience a chance to meet Lee’s latest work.
why_it_matters.korean: 오스카 출품으로 더 많은 관객이 영화를 만날 수 있다.

parties.label: Lee Chang-dong
parties.english: The director examines desire, class and the ethics of watching other people’s suffering.
parties.korean: 이창동은 욕망과 계급과 관찰의 윤리를 살핀다.

parties.label: The two couples
parties.english: Their lives collide after a factory strike and a documentary project.
parties.korean: 두 부부의 삶은 파업과 다큐멘터리로 충돌한다.

parties.label: South Korea
parties.english: The country selected the film for the 99th Academy Awards international feature category.
parties.korean: 한국은 이 영화를 오스카 출품작으로 골랐다.

views.label: The review’s view
views.english: The film uses sharp formal control to show how wealth shapes intimacy and envy.
views.korean: 영화는 부가 친밀감과 질투를 바꾸는 모습을 보인다.

views.label: A more cautious view
views.english: Some critics may find its long, serious examination of class too heavy or sentimental.
views.korean: 일부 평론가는 계급 이야기가 무겁다고 볼 수 있다.

disagree.english: Viewers may disagree about whether the film criticizes privilege or simply studies human weakness.
disagree.korean: 관객은 특권 비판인지 인간 약점 관찰인지 다르게 볼 수 있다.

cards.english_title: Who is Alice Huang in the Nvidia espionage allegations?
cards.korean_desc: 앨리스 황은 엔비디아 CEO를 염탐한 혐의를 받는다. 미국은 중국에 첨단 엔비디아 칩 수출을 제한한다. 그녀는 엔비디아 고객 메가스피드에서 일했다. 보도는 2025년 조사와 적은 공개 정보를 전한다.
cards.english_desc: Alice Huang is a Chinese executive accused of spying on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. The allegations matter because Washington restricts advanced Nvidia chip exports to China. She reportedly worked at Singapore-based Megaspeed, a major Nvidia customer. Reports say Singapore authorities questioned Alice Huang in 2025, but public details remain limited.
cards.hook: Alice Huang is accused of gathering intelligence for Beijing.
cards.korean_hook: 앨리스 황은 베이징 정보 수집 혐의를 받는다.
cards.takeaway_english: The investigation must establish what Alice Huang did, when she did it, and what evidence supports it.
cards.takeaway_korean: 조사는 행동과 시기와 증거를 밝혀야 한다.

why_it_matters.english: The allegations involve restricted AI chips and U.S.-China technology competition.
why_it_matters.korean: 의혹은 제한된 AI 칩과 미중 기술 경쟁에 관련된다.

why_it_matters.english: The case could affect Nvidia’s business relationships and national-security scrutiny.
why_it_matters.korean: 사건은 엔비디아의 사업 관계와 안보 조사를 바꿀 수 있다.

parties.label: Alice Huang
parties.english: She is described as a Chinese executive linked to Singapore-based Megaspeed.
parties.korean: 그녀는 싱가포르 메가스피드의 중국인 간부로 알려졌다.

parties.label: Jensen Huang
parties.english: He leads Nvidia and acknowledged an intimate relationship with Alice Huang.
parties.korean: 그는 엔비디아 CEO이며 앨리스 황과의 관계를 인정했다.

parties.label: Megaspeed International
parties.english: The data-centre company bought more than $4.8 billion in Nvidia chips over two years.
parties.korean: 메가스피드는 2년 동안 칩을 48억 달러 넘게 샀다.

views.label: The New York Times and Wall Street Journal reporting

views.korean: 미국 관리들은 앨리스 황이 황 CEO를 노렸다고 봤다.
